items.title: Show Effective Options
items.description: view current option values influenced by tmux-sensible

action.popup:
sh -lc 'printf "server options
"; for opt in escape-time display-time; do tmux show-options -s "$opt"; done; printf "
global options
"; for opt in history-limit status-interval default-terminal status-keys focus-events; do tmux show-options -g "$opt"; done; printf "
window options
"; for opt in aggressive-resize mode-keys; do tmux show-options -gw "$opt"; done; printf "
press enter to close
"; read -r _'
